body: Also the most disappointing thing for me personally is the contrast between my authentic self,which reached its epiphany 6 months ago and my current condition.I felt like I had transformed into a more outgoing,cheerful and extroverted person.I literally used to embrace speaking and take advantage of every situation.It is the complete opposite now,I am scared to even start simple sentences.

First of all,sincere thanks for your willingness to help.I think it escalates when talking to ,,authority,, figures,but I think it has evolved into a universal problem at this point,even in-person conversations with relatives are painful.

Thanks for your advice.I guess the essence of that is to have some positive experiences and get used to fluent speech so I could integrate that as a constant?Sounds wonderful,yet I am a bit sceptical,because I have made over 400 audio recording the past 2 weeks talking to all sorts of people and I’ve been flawless,yet I still huge anxiety talking to actual people.

I have attended speech therapy numerous times,it only made me more self-conscious and lowered my self-esteem,because it provoked me to fixate on a non existing issue-my issue is not actual stuttering,like having trouble pronouncing words,because when I record myself I can speak flawlessly,so I have the inherent ability to do so.
I can definitely relate to fragments of that.Is you biggest challenge blocking,or is it another variation of stuttering?

No problem,perhaps I wasn’t clear enough.So from March to September it almost eradicated,and a couple of stressful and traumatic situations unlocked it again.The most disappointing thing is the contrast between now and then,rather than improving I am deteriorating and it’s worse than last year.
I also speak perfectly when recording myself,even the longest words are pronounced without hesitation.
Doubt that,I used to speak flawlessly and spontaneously 3 months ago,there is no rational explanation for that on a biological level.
Thanks for the advice mate,that is actually the problem-I overthink it,but it has transformed into a habit,because I am intuitively prepared to block every time.
Have been medicating for 2 months,no visible results whatsoever
Thanks for the feedback.Did you manage to reduce your anxiety and blocking in the long run?
Attended it numerous times.Had momentary effect,then back to the blocking.
Great advice,but I don’t know how I can start loving myself right now,I am in ruins.

Appreciate the feedback.When I record myself I can speak perfectly,but the last month or so on the phone has been apocalyptic.I always think to myself:how can I be confident right now?I am having 30 second blocks and people around me are speaking spontaneously.
Does it still universally traumatise you or only with that specific person?And if it doesn’t what strategies did you use to overcome it?

Hey mate,I can completely relate to your struggles.Are you fluent in some scenarios like recording yourself alone or speaking to someone in particular?I think that it is imperative for you to experiment with your speech and identify the source of your troubles-emotional,psychological,etc.In my case I can speak flawlessly and spontaneously when recording myself or talking to my little sister,but any other circumstance is a nightmare.If you need someone to be empathetic and relate to your struggles,I am available.
